SEO Power Rankings: 12 Crypto Casinos by Organic Traffic, Brand Lift & Non-Brand Reach

I was curious to see how crypto casinos stacked up in terms of top-line organic metrics.

(I'll be publishing more insights on the trade section of https://t.co/o6bYLqmER1 - You can read this one at https://t.co/ZauepW7mgw)

All figures come from @ahrefs (June 2025 crawl). Treat them as directional, not gospel.

Methodology & caveats

I selected the 12 crypto-casino domains with the most significant Tanzanite market-share footprint. Because Tanzanite can’t track every chain or all major crypto casinos, consider this list representative, not a definitive “Top 12”.

And the top five country referrers for each. Very interesting!

- @Stake : India 44%, US 14.6%, Canada 7.2%, Brazil 4.4%, Argentina 3.7%

- @Roobet : India 29.9%, Canada 15.3%, US 10.1%, Finland 7.2%, Slovenia 5.9%

- @bcgame : India 51.1%, Nigeria 9.7%, Brazil 9.1%, Indonesia 3.5%, Germany 3.0%

- @shufflecom : Japan 40.7%, US 11.4%, Philippines 6.2%, India 3.7%, Hungary 3.2%

- @gamdom : Norway 9.9%, UK 9.5%, New Zealand 8.3%, Australia 5.9%

- @Bitcasinoio : Japan 43%, US 9.6%, Brazil 7.0%, France 6.2%, Vietnam 5.6%

- @rollbit : US 42.7%, UK 8.4%, Canada 5.3%, Lithuania 2.7%, Australia 2.6%

- @rainbetcom : US 63.8%, Canada 31.5%, UK 1.7%, Turkey 0.8%, India 0.7%

- @500Casino : Germany 16.3%, Poland 11.3%, US 7.5%, Lithuania 7.3%, UK 6.4%

- @Duelbits : US 21.9%, Germany 19.8%, Canada 6.9%, India 6.5%, Brazil 3.0%

- @Meta_Winners  : US 42.8%, Thailand 10.2%, UK 7.0%, India 6.3%, Philippines 4.3%

- @betfury_gaming : Brazil 45.4%, Philippines 5.4%, US 5.0%, Poland 4.5%, Spain 2.9%

The traffic buckets measured

- Branded traffic – queries that include the casino’s name, a proxy for brand equity.

- Non-branded traffic – generic or intent-based searches that omit the brand. This slice is still tiny for most crypto casinos.

- Top-five countries – the leading referrers of organic traffic for each site.

VPN note: heavy VPN usage in gambling skews geo data, so treat country splits as directional.

Data source & limitations

- All metrics pulled from Ahrefs (June 2025 crawl)—directional, not gospel.

- Some casinos have years of SEO history; others launched recently, so comparisons aren’t apples-to-apples.

Glossary

- Domain Rating (DR) – Ahrefs’ 0-100 backlink-authority score.

- Backlinks – total external links pointing at the domain.

- Keywords – search terms ranking in the global top 100.

- Traffic – estimated monthly organic visits.

- Value – CPC-based dollar value of that traffic.

Explain ko sayo ng maayos ah.

Have you seen the GROWTH of Esnyr's content (series and yung mga casual vids niya)

The quality is improving exponentially. 

Why? 

Paraphrasing Mr Beast, "Everything that we made last video is invested to the next. Sometimes even a deficit"

The reality of a self-run, constantly improving, content creator page is habang lumalaki ang base mo, lumolobo rin gastos mo.

You constantly need to ONE UP your previous entries. 

More quality, more pasabog, more manpower, more talents and more artistic ideas (and these ideas come from networking, canvassing talents and picking expert's brains).

Putting it in perspective:
Kahit say natin 5M ang isang kita ng isang influencer sa isang video

- Magkano manpower?
- location?
- costume?
- logistics?

Magkano ba talaga ang take home ni Esnyr PER video? Probably small.

Si Esnyr naman kasi, nakikita mo sa video quality niya na THEY ARE CONTINUOUSLY improving. So gumagastos talaga siya - sa equipment, sa location, and yes sa networking (kasi important yan)

So yung 200K from 4th BP might be enough for Esnyr to break even kasi baka nasa deficit siya ngayon. 

Why did Esnyr join PBB?

They were hoping PBB will bring the traffic they need for their content creator career to further take off. They were probably hoping na with PBB, they don't need to invest so much on marketing and networking. Perhaps, PBB's exposure should be enough to soldier on in the upcoming near future.

May point is: Hindi glimz and glam lang ang income ni Esnyr kasi, there is VERIFIABLE proof sa quality ng output niya and manpower niya na they are continuously spending for their craft. Kaya most probably maliit lang talaga kita niya.

I'll end with a quote

“Naisip ko din kasi na, since I have the resources naman na, which is because of the people’s support, deserve naman nila mabigyan ng high quality school content in return,” he continues. “Above all, gusto ko rin magpasaya ng mas maraming tao and makapagbigay-aliw at nostalgia hindi lamang sa isang platform kundi sa YouTube na din.”

Interview by Raphael Bautista, Nylon Manila, June 17, 2022.

Brazil’s Interest in Akash Air Defence System: India’s Rising Influence in Global Defence Exports (Quick Read)

India’s emergence as a formidable player in the #DefenceExport market has gained momentum, with Brazil expressing keen interest in acquiring the indigenously developed #AkashAirDefenceSystem, a medium-range surface-to-air missile (SAM) engineered by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (#DRDO). The Akash, a battle-proven system, demonstrated its prowess during #OperationSindoor in May 2025, successfully intercepting Pakistani drones and missiles with an 88-99% kill probability, protecting critical Indian assets. Brazil’s Strategic Program for Air Defence, led by General Tomas Miguel Paiva, seeks to address gaps in its medium-altitude air defence capabilities, currently limited to 3,000 meters. The system’s cost-effectiveness—priced under $500,000 per missile compared to the $1.2-1.5 million Patriot—and its 96% indigenous content make it an attractive option for Brazil, as confirmed by Secretary East P. Kumaran during a June 30, 2025, briefing ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Brazil for the #BRICSSummit2025.

The Akash system, produced by Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) and Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) with contributions from private firms like Tata Power and Larsen & Toubro, offers a range of 25-45 km for the Akash Mk-1 and up to 70-80 km for the advanced #AkashNG variant. Its Rajendra radar enables simultaneous engagement of four targets, as demonstrated in a 2023 live-fire exercise observed by a Brazilian delegation. Brazil’s interest, sparked during the India-Brazil 2+2 talks in February 2024, extends beyond procurement to potential co-production, aligning with its aerospace capabilities through Embraer, as noted in a February 2024 MoU with Mahindra Defence Systems. This collaboration could see reciprocal deals, with India considering Brazil’s Embraer C-390 Millennium for its Medium Transport Aircraft program, strengthening bilateral ties under the leadership of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and PM Modi.

The Akash’s global appeal is bolstered by its export success, notably a $690 million deal with Armenia in 2023, with deliveries starting in November 2024, and interest from nations like the UAE, Philippines, Egypt, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, and Belarus. Its performance in #OperationSindoor, integrated with India’s Integrated Air Command and Control System (IACCS) and Akashteer network, showcased its ability to counter diverse threats, from drones to cruise missiles, outshining competitors like China’s Sky Dragon 50, which Brazil is also evaluating. General Paiva’s push for a government-to-government (G2G) deal, as reported in April 2025, highlights Akash’s edge in interoperability and affordability, critical for Brazil’s vast terrain. The system’s mobility on wheeled and tracked platforms, praised by DRDO’s former chairman G. Satheesh Reddy, ensures rapid deployment, making it ideal for Brazil’s strategic needs.

As PM Modi prepares for the BRICS Summit in Rio de Janeiro from July 5-8, 2025, discussions with President Lula are expected to advance this #DefenceCooperation, potentially culminating in a landmark deal. Posts on X reflect enthusiasm for India’s #MakeInIndia initiative, with users like @IndianTechGuide and @Sudhanshu_I_N_D noting Brazil’s interest as a boost for India’s defence exports. While negotiations remain in early stages, as Kumaran cautioned, the Akash’s proven track record and India’s growing technological prowess position it as a cornerstone of India-Brazil strategic partnership. This development not only underscores India’s self-reliance under #AatmanirbharBharat but also cements its role as a trusted supplier in the global defence market, challenging traditional Western and Chinese dominance.
